title: Bound-matrix suite
statement: The T020 candidate must add a bound-matrix suite that exercises each declared DecodeLimits member at, below, and above its value; asserts the declared failed/rejected classification with no decoded value on a breach; and asserts a limit below 1 is failed XCOM-DECODE-UNKNOWN.
verification_intent: CTest cases T20BoundMatrix.*; trusted unit measure.
acceptance_criteria: For each of the 13 DecodeLimits members an accepting and a failing case exists.
An over-length string is rejected XCOM-DECODE-SHAPE.
Every zero limit is failed XCOM-DECODE-UNKNOWN and no breach returns a plan.
